verses.en: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
verses.pt: Dirás, pois, naquele dia: Graças te dou, ó Senhor; porque, ainda que te iraste contra mim, a tua ira se retirou, e tu me confortaste.
verses.en_web: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
verses.en_bbe: And in that day you will say I will give praise to you, O Lord; for though you were angry with me, your wrath is turned away, and I am comforted.

verses.en: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.pt: Eis que Deus é a minha salvação; eu confiarei e não temerei porque o Senhor, sim o Senhor é a minha força e o meu cântico; e se tornou a minha salvação.
verses.en_web: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
verses.en_bbe: See, God is my salvation; I will have faith in the Lord, without fear: for the Lord Jah is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.

verses.en: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.pt: Portanto com alegria tirareis águas das fontes da salvação.
verses.en_web: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.en_bbe: So with joy will you get water out of the springs of salvation.

verses.en: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.pt: E direis naquele dia: Dai graças ao Senhor, invocai o seu nome, fazei notórios os seus feitos entre os povos, proclamai quão excelso é o seu nome.
verses.en_web: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that his name is exalted!
verses.en_bbe: And in that day you will say, Give praise to the Lord, let his name be honoured, give word of his doings among the peoples, say that his name is lifted up.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
verses.pt: Cantai ao Senhor; porque fez coisas grandiosas; saiba-se isso em toda a terra.
verses.en_web: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
verses.en_bbe: Make a song to the Lord; for he has done noble things: give news of them through all the earth.

verses.en: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
verses.pt: Exulta e canta de gozo, ó habitante de Sião; porque grande é o Santo de Israel no meio de ti.
verses.en_web: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
verses.en_bbe: Let your voice be sounding in a cry of joy, O daughter of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you.
